You will also mentor engineers, influence architectural decisions, and raise engineering standards through strong technical judgment and collaboration. Contribute to service-oriented and event-driven architecture while helping shape the technical foundation supporting a large-scale product ecosystem. Connect backend engineering decisions to customer outcomes, business priorities, reliability, and long-term maintainability. Help raise the overall quality bar through effective engineering practices, production ownership, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement. Requirements: Strong expertise in Node.js and proven experience building and operating production-grade backend systems. Staff-level backend engineering experience with a strong track record developing high-scale APIs, services, distributed systems, or shared product capabilities. Strong command of backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, Elixir, Ruby/Rails, Java, Go, Python, or comparable technologies, including runtime behavior, failure modes, and production trade-offs. Advanced SQL and relational database knowledge, including indexing, query optimization, migrations, profiling, data modeling, transactions, read/write patterns, and performance tuning. Practical understanding of service-oriented and event-driven architectures, queues, background jobs, webhooks, Redis or similar caching technologies, and systems operating under significant production load. Working knowledge of infrastructure and platform concepts, including deployments, containers, CI/CD, cloud services, networking fundamentals, observability, and operational debugging. Strong production ownership mindset with the ability to use logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, and incident reviews
